payload.name: Bird
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bird is the communications infrastructure AI agents operate. Every agent eventually has to reach a human — verify a sign-up, confirm an order, chase an invoice, answer an inbox, place a call. Connect Bird and Codex does all of it for real: email, SMS, and WhatsApp on Bird's own sending infrastructure and carrier connections, calls on Bird SIP trunks, live events to every open browser and app over Bird Realtime — with a delivery timestamp or the exact failure reason instead of a guess.

And Codex doesn't just send through Bird — it can own the endpoints. It claims its agent a durable email address in one call and answers what arrives there. It buys a phone number, gets it verified for texting, and registers the 10DLC campaign behind it. It sets up a SIP trunk and proves the caller ID with a real verification call. Addresses, numbers, trunks, and the compliance behind them — acquired in conversation.

Whatever your account can do, Codex can do here. The tools are generated from Bird's live API — the same surface Bird's own dashboard runs on — so the list Codex shows is always the current one and grows as Bird does. Some of it works before you even connect: grade any domain's live email authentication, analyze headers and DMARC reports, or search Bird's docs, no account needed.

You sign in with Bird when you connect, so there is no API key to paste and no secret sitting in your config.toml. Codex gets only the permissions you already hold, and you can revoke them from your Bird profile.

A good first ask: "Send me a test email and tell me the moment it's delivered." Building an agent? "Claim yourself an email address and reply to whatever arrives."
payload.longDescription:
Bird是AI代理运行的通信基础设施。每个代理最终都需要与人类进行交互——验证注册、确认订单、催促发票、处理邮件收件箱、拨打电话。连接Bird和Codex即可真实完成所有操作：通过Bird自有发送基础设施和运营商连接发送邮件、短信和WhatsApp，通过Bird SIP中继进行电话沟通，通过Bird实时技术向每个打开的浏览器和应用发起实时事件——提供交付时间戳或确切的失败原因，而非猜测。

Codex不仅通过Bird发送信息——它还能掌控终端。它可在一次调用中为代理申请一个持久化电子邮件地址并处理收到的内容。它会购买电话号码、完成短信验证，并在该号码后注册10DLC活动。它会设置SIP中继并通过真实验证通话证明主叫号码。地址、号码、中继以及背后的合规性——所有内容均通过对话完成获取。

您账户能完成的任何操作，Codex都能实现。工具来自Bird的实时API——与Bird自身仪表盘使用的相同界面——因此Codex展示的列表始终为最新状态，并随Bird的更新而扩展。在连接前即可使用部分功能：实时检测任意域名的邮件认证、分析邮件头和DMARC报告，或搜索Bird文档，无需账户。

连接时通过Bird登录，无需粘贴API密钥或在config.toml中保存秘密。Codex仅获取您已拥有的权限，您可随时从Bird个人资料中撤销这些权限。

一个好的初始请求：「发送测试邮件并告知送达时刻」。若在构建代理：「为自己申请一个电子邮件地址并回复收到的内容」。

payload.name: Bland
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your Bland voice agents from ChatGPT. Review call transcripts and outcomes, check call volume and completion rates, and inspect saved agent configurations.

Ask Bland to place or stop a call, prepare an agent change, or deploy a selected saved version. You can also validate a supplied pathway graph, score calls with existing evaluation judges, and find answers in Bland's documentation.

payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT管理您的Bland语音代理。
查看通话记录和结果，检查通话量和完成率，并查看保存的代理配置。

让Bland发起或终止通话，准备代理变更，或部署已保存的版本。

payload.name: Thrixel

Everything runs on Thrixel's servers, so there is nothing to install: connect your Thrixel account once and ask for a game.
payload.longDescription: Build World可将一句话的游戏创意转化为可在浏览器中游玩的3D游戏。它将确定您正在制作的内容，通过Thrixel生成3D模型（您拥有所有权的游戏就绪.glb文件），围绕这些模型编写three.js游戏（包含场景、控制、UI和触控输入），并通过可共享的thrixel.world公开链接进行发布。所有内容均在Thrixel的服务器上运行，因此无需任何安装：只需连接您的Thrixel账户一次并请求生成游戏。

payload.name: Currents
payload.description: 修复失败的测试。验证拉取请求。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Currents gives AI agents the test results your CI records, from Playwright, Vitest, Jest and more.

Self-healing tests
• Ask why a run failed and get the errors, stack traces, screenshots and traces behind it
• Step through a run's Playwright trace, action by action, to see what the page did
• Find the root cause and fix the test, flaky ones included
• Compare a pull request's runs with main to see what the change broke

Proof of work for any change
• Before-and-after screenshots, videos, Playwright traces and DOM snapshots from CI
• A demo the agent records in a browser, saved as a run
• Evidence links posted in the pull request, so reviewers see the change working

Test suite health
• Rank your flakiest and slowest tests and spec files
• See which errors break the most tests
• Quarantine, skip or tag tests with rules, and review what they affected

Day-to-day CI work
• Reproduce a bug from a failed run and verify the fix
• Open an issue for a failure in your issue tracker
• Cancel, reset or re-check runs without leaving the chat

For teams whose CI slows them down: flaky tests that block merges, failures nobody has time to dig into, and AI-written pull requests that are hard to trust without seeing the change work. Works with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Jira, Linear and more. You need a Currents account.
payload.longDescription:
Currents 会将你的 CI 记录的测试结果（来自 Playwright、Vitest、Jest 等）提供给 AI 代理。

自愈测试
• 查询运行失败原因并获取相关错误信息、堆栈跟踪、截图和追踪记录
• 逐步查看 Playwright 的运行追踪记录，逐个动作观察页面行为
• 定位根本原因并修复测试（包括不稳定的测试）
• 将拉取请求的运行结果与主分支对比，查看更改破坏了哪些内容

任何更改的证明
• 来自 CI 的前后截图、视频、Playwright 追踪记录和 DOM 快照
• 代理在浏览器中录制的演示，保存为一次运行
• 在拉取请求中发布证据链接，让评审人员直观看到更改效果

测试套件健康度
• 对最不稳定和最慢的测试及规格文件进行排名
• 查看哪些错误导致最多测试失败
• 通过规则对测试进行隔离、跳过或标记，并审查它们影响的内容

日常 CI 工作
• 从失败运行中复现错误并验证修复
• 在你的问题跟踪器中为失败创建工单
• 在不离开聊天界面的情况下取消、重置或重新检查运行

适用于 CI 成为瓶颈的团队：阻塞合并的不稳定测试、无人问津的失败问题，以及难以信任的 AI 编写拉取请求。支持 GitHub、GitLab、Slack、Jira、Linear 等平台。需要 Currents 账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find the root cause of failing tests, Fix flaky tests, Compare pull request runs with main, Find runs by branch, commit or pull request, Follow a test's history across runs, Rank flaky and slow tests and spec files, See which errors break the most tests, Quarantine, skip and tag tests, Review which tests a rule affected, Explore Playwright traces step by step through a trace API, Collect screenshots, videos and traces from CI, Capture real DOM snapshots as evidence, Record a browser demo of a change, Attach high-fidelity proof to pull requests: videos, traces and DOM snapshots of the change working, Create expiring share links to traces, Reproduce bugs and verify fixes, Open issues for test failures, Cancel, reset and delete runs, Cancel GitHub Actions workflows from a run, Integrate with Linear, Jira, Slack and more

payload.name: Codiedev Reports
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Codiedev Reports answers engineering leaders' questions from their Codiedev reporting, right in the conversation. Ask how engineering is doing this month, whether AI-assisted pull requests actually merge faster, which repositories drive AI spend, how adoption is going on a team, or which models people use and how reliable they are.

Who it's for: company admins, CTOs and team managers whose company uses Codiedev to capture AI coding sessions and pull requests. Admins see the whole company and can narrow to any team. Team managers see only their own team and never see spend. Engineers can't connect.

What it can do: read delivery and cycle-time stages, the AI-vs-no-AI comparison with its classification coverage, velocity and the throughput forecast, daily activity and rate-limit pressure, adoption and skill reuse, model usage and reliability, capture coverage, and (admins only) spend versus the prior period, ROI, cost per merge, seats and the spend forecast.

Limitations: it is read-only and can't change anything in Codiedev. It reports team and company aggregates, not individual session transcripts. Numbers come from stored rollups refreshed about hourly, over 30, 60 or 90-day windows, and only cover sessions Codiedev captured; every answer can quote capture coverage so you know how complete it is. A Codiedev account with the Admin or Team manager role is required.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Engineering overview for the company or a team, AI impact on cycle time and review, Velocity trends and throughput forecast, AI adoption and skill reuse, Model usage and reliability, AI spend, ROI and cost per merge (admins)

Explore structured data, content depth, entity authority, technical AEO and available AI visibility evidence. Get a publicly accessible report you can share, plus an explanation in your conversation. Built for website owners, marketers and developers. Data availability varies, and heuristic scores estimate readiness rather than prove actual AI mentions. Results do not guarantee rankings or inclusion in AI answers. The submitted domain is processed by ProjectA and its audit providers. Service limits apply.

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: SportsAPIs.dev
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SportsAPIs.dev helps developers pick a sports odds API or sports data API for the app, model or odds comparison tool they are building. The plugin answers from the SportsAPIs.dev directory: 42 providers researched by hand, with a written review page for each one.

What it does:
- Find sports APIs by what you need: sport or league (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, tennis, esports and more), live odds, WebSocket streaming, Bet365 or Pinnacle odds, historical and closing odds, player props, futures, same game parlay odds, bet deeplinks, bet settlement, stats, schedules, live scores, box scores, play-by-play and official MCP servers. Filter by free tier, price tier and region.
- Compare two to four providers side by side on the same researched feature set, with the differences called out.
- Read what the SportsAPIs.dev review says about one provider: feature support, pricing tiers, strengths, the full review text, FAQs and alternatives.

Every answer links to the matching review page on sportsapis.dev, so you can read the full write-up and reach the provider from there.

Who it is for: developers building sports apps, betting tools, odds comparison sites, sports analytics, trading models or AI agents that need a sports odds API, a sportsbook odds feed or a sports data API.

Limitations: the plugin covers API providers only. It has no live odds, no scores and no match data, and it gives no betting picks or wagering advice. Feature statuses come from SportsAPIs.dev research (yes, no, or unknown when unverified or plan-dependent). Sport lists reflect sports named in each written review, not a verified coverage list; check the provider's own docs before you build. Some provider links carry SportsAPIs.dev referral parameters, disclosed on the site; they cost you nothing.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find sports odds and data APIs, Compare API providers, Read provider reviews

Connect it to manage inventory across locations, create discount codes, review orders and customer details, and pull analytics on your store’s performance. Shopify supports selling online, in person, B2B, on marketplaces, and selling internationally. Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.

payload.name: DNS Doctor - DNS & DMARC Tools
payload.summaryOriginal: Scan, fix and verify your DNS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check, fix and verify any domain's DNS, explained in plain English. DNS Doctor reads the records behind a domain, tells you what is wrong and why, and gives you the exact record to publish when there is one.

Scan a domain for email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), mail routing (MX), DNS health, blacklists and domain and SSL certificate expiry. Look up any record on the domain's own nameservers, see whether a change has reached resolvers in six locations, check reverse DNS for a mail server, count SPF lookups, audit the third-party includes an SPF record trusts, and read a domain's registration: registrar, expiry, nameservers and locks.

DMARC records are generated and validated by a deterministic engine that follows the RFCs. The AI writes the explanation, never the record. SPF is diagnosed but never rewritten, because a changed SPF record can silently cut off a real sender. Nothing is applied to your DNS: you publish every record yourself.

Connect your DNS Doctor account to work with your monitored domains from ChatGPT: add a domain, check its ownership record, and read the alerts DNS Doctor raises for record changes, expiry, blacklisting, registrar or nameserver changes and new email senders seen in DMARC reports. It also tells you when that report evidence says it is safe to move DMARC from none to quarantine and then to reject.
payload.longDescription:
用通俗易懂的中文解释，检查、修复并验证任何域名的DNS。DNS Doctor会分析域名背后的记录，告知您具体问题及原因，并在需要时提供应发布的精确记录。

扫描域名的邮件认证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）、邮件路由（MX）、DNS健康状况、黑名单以及域名和SSL证书到期情况。可查询域名自有DNS服务器上的任意记录，查看变更是否已到达六个地区的解析器，检查邮件服务器的反向DNS，统计SPF查询次数，审计SPF记录信任的第三方来源，并查看域名的注册信息：注册商、到期时间、DNS服务器和锁定状态。

DMARC记录由遵循RFC标准的确定性引擎生成并验证。AI仅负责撰写解释说明，不生成记录本身。SPF会进行诊断但不会被修改，因为更改SPF记录可能无声地切断真实发件人。您的DNS不会被任何操作影响：所有记录需您自行发布。

将DNS Doctor账户连接至ChatGPT，即可通过其管理监控中的域名：添加域名、检查所有权记录，并查看DNS Doctor针对记录变更、到期、黑名单、注册商或DNS服务器变更以及DMARC报告中出现的新发件人所发出的警报。当报告证据显示可安全地将DMARC策略从无（none）调整为隔离（quarantine）再调整为拒绝（reject）时，系统也会为您提示。

payload.summaryOriginal: Use Google Ads, Meta Ads & PPC
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HYPD connects your advertising platforms, analytics, ecommerce, and search data to ChatGPT and is built for PPC and paid media marketers, agencies, freelancers, ecommerce brands, and small business owners.

Platforms
HYPD connects your Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Advertising/Bing Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Merchant Center, and Google Search Console to ChatGPT.

Included marketing data
Built-in competitor-analysis tools help marketers research competing ads on Google & Meta Ads(ad libraries), research keywords (Keyword Planner), analyze Google SERPs and Google Shopping data, find competitors and audit landing pages.

Use HYPD to:
- Run detailed Google Ads audits across campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, search terms, bidding strategies, budgets, and conversion tracking.
- Mine Google Ads search terms to find high-intent queries, new keyword opportunities, irrelevant searches, negative-keyword ideas, and non-converting spend.
- Diagnose Google Ads performance changes and wasted spend by comparing metrics such as CPC, CTR, conversions, CPA, and ROAS across periods, campaign types, devices, locations, and audiences.
- Discover keywords using Keyword Planner data and forecast potential impressions, clicks, CPC, demand, and advertising costs.
- Analyze Meta Ads at the campaign, ad-set, ad, and creative levels to understand spend, reach, clicks, conversions, CPA, and ROAS.
- Identify winning and fatigued Meta creatives, compare audiences and placements, and investigate delivery, pixel, catalog, or product-feed issues.
- Diagnose GA4, consent, attribution, conversion-tracking, and funnel problems, including differences between advertising platforms and GA4.
- Troubleshoot Merchant Center disapprovals, product-feed problems, weak Shopping visibility, price competitiveness, and underperforming products.
- Investigate website and organic-search traffic declines, audit landing pages, plan campaign tests, and prepare reports for business owners or clients.

Solutions
For eCommerce shops and SMBs, HYPD connects all important marketing data and turns it into clear answers about budgets, results, and next steps. eCommerce shops can also investigate product-feed issues, Shopping performance, customer journeys, and revenue attribution.

For agencies and freelancers, HYPD helps analyze multiple client accounts, explain performance changes, uncover optimization opportunities, and prepare client-ready reports.

HYPD is read-only: it analyzes data and recommends actions but does not change campaigns, budgets, ads, or account settings.
payload.longDescription:
HYPD将您的广告平台、分析工具、电商数据和搜索数据连接至ChatGPT，专为按点击付费广告及付费媒体营销人员、代理机构、自由职业者、电商品牌和中小企业主打造。

平台
HYPD将您的Google Ads、Meta Ads、Microsoft Advertising/Bing Ads、LinkedIn Ads、Google Analytics 4、Merchant Center和Google Search Console连接至ChatGPT。

包含的营销数据
内置的竞争对手分析工具帮助营销人员研究Google和Meta Ads上的竞品广告（广告库），研究关键词（关键词规划师），分析Google搜索结果页面和Google购物数据，发现竞争对手并审核着陆页。

使用HYPD可实现：
- 跨广告系列、广告组、广告、关键词、搜索词、出价策略、预算和转化跟踪对Google Ads进行详细审核。
- 提取Google Ads搜索词以发现高意图查询、新关键词机会、无关搜索、否定关键词创意和非转化支出。
- 通过比较CPC、CTR、转化率、CPA和ROAS等指标在不同时间段、广告系列类型、设备、地理位置和受众群体间的差异，诊断Google Ads表现变化和浪费支出。
- 利用关键词规划师数据发现关键词并预测潜在展示次数、点击量、CPC、需求和广告成本。
- 在广告系列、广告组、广告和创意层级分析Meta Ads，了解支出、覆盖范围、点击量、转化率、CPA和ROAS。
- 识别表现优异和疲劳的Meta创意，对比受众群体和投放位置，并调查投放、像素、目录或产品-feed问题。
- 诊断GA4、同意弹窗、归因、转化跟踪和漏斗问题，包括广告平台与GA4之间的差异。
- 解决Merchant Center审核未通过、产品-feed问题、弱化购物可见性、价格竞争力不足和表现不佳产品问题。
- 调查网站和自然搜索流量下降情况，审核着陆页，规划广告测试并为业主或客户准备报告。

解决方案
对于电商店铺和中小型企业，HYPD连接所有重要营销数据并转化为关于预算、成果和下一步行动的清晰答案。电商店铺还可调查产品-feed问题、购物表现、客户旅程和收入归因。

对于代理机构和自由职业者，HYPD可帮助分析多个客户账户，解释表现变化，发现优化机会并准备客户可用的报告。

HYPD 为只读模式：它会分析数据并提出建议，但不会更改广告活动、预算、广告或账户设置。

payload.name: Vibe Prospecting
payload.description: 寻找潜在客户和B2B联系人数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.
payload.longDescription:
Vibe Prospecting 将实时B2B数据引入ChatGPT，用于潜在客户开发、线索研究和数据增强。该工具整合了来自50多个数据源的1.5亿+企业数据和8亿+专业人脉数据，您可以在不离开对话界面的情况下创建潜在客户名单、研究目标客户并补充缺失的联系信息。

搜索企业信息。用自然语言描述您的理想客户画像，并通过行业（包含领英行业分类、NAICS和SIC分类）、员工数量、营收范围、地理位置、融资阶段以及企业使用的技术进行筛选。搜索结果以结构化列表形式返回，支持进一步优化、排序和导出。

精准定位关键人物。通过职位名称、职级、部门、地理位置、技能和工作经历搜索专业人脉。可通过姓名和企业查询特定人员，或绘制目标客户的决策者网络（包含组织架构和汇报关系），为多线程触达策略提供支持。

获取完整联系信息。获取企业邮箱和电话号码，并附带验证状态，确保触达名单可直接使用。可补全部分记录中的信息缺口（例如有姓名和企业但无邮箱的情况）。在发送前验证现有邮箱地址，并标记需要更新的记录。

追踪采购信号。查看哪些企业完成融资、发布新闻、扩大团队规模、发布相关职位或关键人员发生变动。利用这些动态把握触达时机，进行线索评分并优先处理重点客户。

增强现有数据记录。粘贴或上传企业/联系人名单，追加公司属性数据、技术属性数据、联系信息和最新动态。该应用能精准匹配数据记录，标记重复项，并生成可导出为CSV格式的整洁表格，用于CRM系统、ATS或触达工具。

适用人群：构建合格销售线索池的销售团队和SDR（销售发展代表）；按职位、技能和地理位置寻找候选人的招聘人员；进行客户分层、市场测算和提升CRM数据质量的RevOps及市场团队。同时支持市场测算与TAM分析、线索评分、区域规划和基于客户的战略营销名单构建。

尝试以下提示：

「查找使用HubSpot的美国SaaS公司，员工规模在100到1000人之间。」
「识别这些账户中的高管决策者并获取验证过的办公邮箱。」
「通过行业、员工数量、营收和科技栈来完善这份名单。」
「这些公司中有哪家在最近6个月内获得过融资或扩大了员工规模？」
「寻找奥斯汀地区具有金融科技经验的后端工程师并获取其个人资料。」
「为我的目标客户画像构建潜在客户名单并按匹配度排序。」
「绘制这家公司的销售管理层组织架构图。」
「验证这份名单中的邮箱地址并标记高风险项。」
「预估有多少家美国公司符合这个目标客户画像。」
「根据每个联系人公司的最新新闻撰写个性化冷邮件开场白。」
Vibe Prospecting 基于 Explorium 的 B2B 数据平台开发。
数据在查询时实时获取，而非来自静态导出，因此结果会反映最新的公司和联系人信息。

接使用的版式，保持品牌一致并节省时间。询问活动表现，立即了解哪些因素推动结果、哪

里需要关注以及原因。连接或创建
 Mailchimp 账户即可导入素材并触达受众。

payload.name: Instantly.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instantly.ai helps users manage Instantly.ai email accounts, campaigns, leads, inbox activity, analytics, and background jobs through ChatGPT. The app supports listing and inspecting workspace data, creating and updating campaigns and lead lists, importing and moving leads, managing sender accounts, replying to email threads, verifying email deliverability, and checking campaign or warmup performance.
payload.longDescription: Instantly.ai 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理 Instantly.ai 邮件账户、营销活动、潜在客户、收件箱动态、分析数据和后台作业。该应用支持列出并检查工作区数据、创建和更新营销活动及潜在客户名单、导入和移动潜在客户、管理发件人账户、回复邮件对话、验证邮件送达能力，以及检查营销活动或预热表现。

payload.name: Attio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Attio connects ChatGPT directly to your CRM workspace, letting you manage customer relationships through natural conversation. 

Search and filter contacts, companies, and deals with flexible queries. Create, update, and organize records without switching between screens. Add notes, manage tasks, and track your sales pipeline—all through simple requests. 

Key capabilities: 
- Search records using powerful filters (find companies by size, industry, last contact date) 
- Create and update people, companies, and deal records 
- Manage notes attached to any record 
- Track and complete tasks 
- Navigate lists and organize your data 

Whether you're preparing for a meeting, updating deal stages, or researching prospects, Attio brings your CRM data into your conversation — no manual data entry required.
payload.longDescription:
Attio 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到你的CRM工作区，让你通过自然对话管理客户关系。

使用灵活查询搜索和筛选联系人、公司及交易。无需切换屏幕，即可创建、更新和整理记录。通过简单请求添加笔记、管理任务并跟踪销售机会管道。

主要功能：
- 使用强大的筛选条件搜索记录（按规模、行业、最后联系日期查找公司）
- 创建和更新人员、公司及交易记录
- 管理附加到任何记录的笔记
- 跟踪并完成任务
- 浏览列表并整理数据

无论你在准备会议、更新交易阶段还是研究潜在客户，Attio 都能将CRM数据带入对话——无需手动录入数据。

payload.name: Close
payload.description: 通过 ChatGPT 使用 Close CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Close stores every call, email, SMS, and meeting your team touches, not just contact records. Connect it to ChatGPT and your conversation history becomes something you can actually work from.

Ask ChatGPT to catch you up on a deal, summarize recent calls, draft follow-ups, update records, or build outreach workflows without bouncing between tools. Close is built around communication. Calls, emails, SMS, and meetings are all logged and searchable, giving ChatGPT far more context than traditional CRMs built mostly for record-keeping.

Close also includes Chloe, a built-in AI sales teammate embedded directly into your workflows. Together, ChatGPT and Chloe help teams stay on top of follow-up, prioritize outreach, and keep deals moving.
payload.longDescription:
Close 会保存团队参与的每次通话、邮件、短信和会议记录，而不仅仅是联系人记录。将它连接到 ChatGPT 后，你的对话历史就能真正用于工作。

你可以让 ChatGPT 帮你快速了解一笔交易、总结近期通话、起草跟进内容、更新记录或构建外联工作流，无需在不同工具之间来回切换。Close 围绕沟通构建。通话、邮件、短信和会议都会被记录并可供搜索，因此 ChatGPT 能获得比主要用于记录信息的传统 CRM 丰富得多的上下文。

Close 还包含内置的 AI 销售伙伴 Chloe，直接嵌入你的工作流。ChatGPT 与 Chloe 协同，帮助团队跟进后续事项、确定外联优先级并推动交易进展。

payload.name: Upwork
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upwork connects clients hiring for work with the freelancers doing it. Clients can post jobs, review proposals, send offers, message freelancers, and manage contracts, milestones, and payments. Freelancers can search and save jobs, submit proposals, respond to invitations and offers, track earnings and time reports, and manage their public profile. Both sides get a consolidated dashboard of what's new.
payload.longDescription: Upwork 将招聘客户与自由职业者连接起来。客户可以发布工作、查看提案、发送邀约、给自由职业者发消息，并管理合同、里程碑和付款。自由职业者可以搜索和保存职位、提交提案、回复邀请和邀约、跟踪收入和工时报告，并管理公开个人资料。双方都能在统一仪表板中查看最新动态。

payload.name: ActiveCampaign
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You already work in ChatGPT. Now drive and track your marketing outcomes there too.
Connect ActiveCampaign in a few clicks. From the chat, you can:

- Understand yesterday's campaign performance in seconds
- Look up a contact and update their information.
- Clean up tags, build segments, and organize your lists.
- Move deals forward without leaving ChatGPT.
- Enroll a contact in automated marketing workflows.

No new tab. No copy paste. No starting over. ChatGPT is the surface you ask from. ActiveCampaign takes action.
payload.longDescription:
你已经在 ChatGPT 中工作，现在也可以在这里推动并跟踪营销成果。
点击几次即可连接 ActiveCampaign。在聊天中，你可以：

- 几秒内了解昨天的营销活动表现
- 查找联系人并更新其信息。
- 清理标签、建立细分群组并整理列表。
- 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可推进交易。
- 将联系人加入自动化营销工作流程。

无需新开标签页，无需复制粘贴，无需从头再来。你在 ChatGPT 中提出请求，ActiveCampaign 负责执行。

payload.name: SE Ranking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SE Ranking connects ChatGPT to SE Ranking's SEO data and project APIs. Research keywords, analyze backlinks and referring domains, study domain and competitor traffic, pull live SERP data, run website audits, track AI Search visibility across ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overview, and manage rank-tracking projects you own.
payload.longDescription: SE Ranking 将 ChatGPT 连接到 SE Ranking 的 SEO 数据和项目 API。研究关键词、分析反向链接和引荐域名、研究域名及竞争对手流量、获取实时 SERP 数据、执行网站审计、追踪 ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI Overview 中的 AI 搜索可见度，并管理你拥有的排名追踪项目。

payload.name: HoneyBook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HoneyBook is where independent businesses and lean teams run their client work: inquiries, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments and the messages in between.

Connect your account and work through a whole job in one conversation. Ask which leads are worth chasing and get a ranked answer from your own bookings. Have the proposal built from your saved template. Review it before it goes anywhere. Later, ask who still owes you money, and raise a payment request for whoever does.

You approve what it can reach before anything runs, resource by resource, and nothing reaches a client until you send it. Each request runs in an isolated environment, and your credentials are never shared with the model.

Built for photographers, event planners, venues, designers and consultants. Requires a HoneyBook account.
payload.longDescription:
HoneyBook 为独立经营者和精简团队提供管理客户工作的场所：咨询、提案、合同、发票、付款，以及各环节之间的消息沟通。

连接账户后，在一次对话中处理完整业务。询问哪些潜在客户值得跟进，它会根据你自己的已预约业务给出排序结果。使用已保存的模板生成提案，并在发出前审阅。之后，可以询问谁还欠款，并向欠款客户发起付款请求。

任何操作运行前，你需要逐项批准它可访问的资源；只有你发送后，内容才会到达客户。每项请求都在隔离环境中运行，你的凭据绝不会共享给模型。

专为摄影师、活动策划人员、场地经营者、设计师和顾问打造。需要 HoneyBook 账户。

payload.name: Sanity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create, query, and manage your structured content in Sanity directly from ChatGPT. Run content audits, update documents, coordinate releases, and find anything across your projects. Or set up entirely new projects – schemas, content, and configuration – just by chatting.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中创建、查询和管理 Sanity 结构化内容。执行内容审核、更新文档、协调发布，并在项目中查找任何内容。也可以只通过聊天设置全新的项目，包括 schema、内容和配置。

payload.name: Planning Center
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Planning Center to ChatGPT to interact with your ministry data through natural conversation. Each user connects with their own account, so ChatGPT only sees what their Planning Center permissions allow.
payload.longDescription: 将 Planning Center 连接到 ChatGPT，通过自然对话使用您的事工数据。每位用户都连接自己的账户，因此 ChatGPT 只能查看该用户 Planning Center 权限所允许的数据。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Google Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Google Ads helps marketers analyze live Google Ads performance. Users can discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and segmentation options, query campaign, ad group, and keyword metrics, connect the Google Ads connector, and safely run supported Google Ads actions such as creating, pausing, enabling, and updating campaigns, ad groups, ads, and keywords, setting budgets, managing bidding, and managing Customer Match audience lists, after confirmation. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Google Ads 帮助营销人员分析实时 Google Ads 成效。用户可以发现已连接的广告账户、查看有效字段和细分选项、查询广告系列、广告组和关键字指标、连接 Google Ads 连接器，并在确认后安全执行受支持的 Google Ads 操作，例如创建、暂停、启用和更新广告系列、广告组、广告和关键字，设置预算、管理出价以及管理 Customer Match 受众名单。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Business Strategy Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your business idea into a clear, shareable strategy.
Use this whether you are starting a new business or sharpening an existing one.
It helps you find the right words to explain what you do, for whom, and why it matters.
That gives you clarity for yourself before you bring others in.
It also helps you make real choices and trade-offs instead of keeping everything open.
You work toward a complete Business Strategy Canvas that fits on one page.
This one-page canvas becomes a simple reference you can use to align decisions and priorities.
At the end, you can export a PPTX presentation to share with co-founders, teammates, clients, or stakeholders.
Use the PPTX to pitch, get buy-in, or kick off a strategy session with everyone on the same page.
If your thinking feels scattered, this turns it into something you can communicate and act on.
payload.longDescription:
将您的商业想法转化为清晰、可分享的策略。无论您是在创办新企业，还是在打磨现有企业，都可以使用它。它帮助您找到合适的语言，说明您做什么、为谁做以及为什么重要，从而在引入他人前先获得自己的清晰认识。它还帮助您做出真实的选择和权衡，而不是让所有选项一直开放。
您将逐步完成一页纸的商业策略画布。这张画布可作为对齐决策和优先级的简单参考。最后，您可以导出 PPTX 演示文稿，与联合创始人、队友、客户或利益相关者分享。用 PPTX 做展示、争取支持，或在所有人目标一致的情况下启动策略会议。如果您的思路杂乱，它会把思路变成可沟通、可行动的方案。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Search Console
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Google Search Console helps SEOs and marketers explore live Search Console data. Users can discover connected Search Console sites, inspect valid dimensions and metrics, and query organic search performance — clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, and date — over any date range, and connect the Search Console connector. It provides read-only analytics: it does not run write actions, submit or change sitemaps, or modify any Search Console settings. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Google Search Console 帮助 SEO 人员和营销人员查看实时 Search Console 数据。用户可以发现已连接的 Search Console 网站，查看有效维度和指标，并按任意日期范围查询自然搜索表现——按查询词、页面、国家/地区、设备和日期细分的点击次数、展示次数、点击率（CTR）和平均排名——还可连接 Search Console 连接器。它提供只读分析：不会执行写入操作、提交或更改站点地图，也不会修改任何 Search Console 设置。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Clutch.co
payload.description: 寻找理想的 B2B 合作伙伴
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Clutch.co brings trusted B2B service provider research and verified client reviews into ChatGPT, helping you confidently find and compare agencies, consultants, and software partners. Discover thousands of vetted companies across marketing, development, design, IT services, and more—each backed by in-depth profiles and detailed feedback from real clients.

Ask questions like “Which digital marketing agencies have the best reviews for SaaS companies?” or “Compare top web development firms based on client satisfaction,” and Clutch highlights review insights, strengths and weaknesses, pricing signals, and relevant experience. Refine your shortlist through natural conversation and make more informed B2B decisions with transparent, review-driven insights—right inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Clutch.co 将可信的 B2B 服务提供商研究和经过验证的客户评价带入 ChatGPT，帮助您自信地寻找和比较代理机构、顾问和软件合作伙伴。发现营销、开发、设计、IT 服务等领域数千家经过审核的公司，每家公司都有详细档案和真实客户反馈。

您可以问：“哪些数字营销机构最适合 SaaS 公司且评价最好？”或“根据客户满意度比较顶尖网页开发公司。”Clutch 会突出评价洞察、优势和弱点、价格信号及相关经验。通过自然对话完善候选名单，借助透明、以评价为基础的洞察，在 ChatGPT 内做出更明智的 B2B 决策。

payload.name: Wialon
payload.description: 随时询问你的车队情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore your fleet data effortlessly through conversation. Wialon — the ultimate fleet digitalization solution tracking 4 million vehicles in 160 countries — brings your real-time operational insights directly into ChatGPT.

Simply ask questions about your vehicle statuses, trips, fuel activity, or geofences, and get clear, visual answers in seconds. It’s a faster, more intuitive way to stay on top of your operations, right where you already chat.

The app is read-only by design, ensuring a secure and transparent way to explore your data at any time.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话轻松探索车队数据。Wialon 是一款车队数字化解决方案，追踪 160 个国家/地区的 4 million 辆车辆，可将实时运营洞察直接带入 ChatGPT。

只需询问车辆状态、行程、燃油活动或地理围栏，即可在几秒钟内获得清晰直观的答案。无需离开熟悉的聊天界面，就能以更快捷、更直观的方式掌握运营情况。

该应用在设计上仅提供只读访问，让你随时以安全、透明的方式探索数据。

payload.name: Upload-Post
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upload-Post helps users publish, schedule, analyze, and manage social media posts from ChatGPT. It supports video, photo, text, and document publishing; scheduling and queue management; analytics; profile management; Instagram comments and DMs; browser-based media staging; and FFmpeg media processing across connected social platforms.
payload.longDescription: Upload-Post 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中发布、安排、分析和管理社交媒体帖子。它支持发布视频、照片、文本和文档；安排发布并管理队列；查看分析数据；管理个人资料；处理 Instagram 评论和私信；通过浏览器暂存媒体；以及在已连接的社交平台上使用 FFmpeg 处理媒体。

payload.name: Tailwind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tailwind helps users generate Pinterest Pin drafts from webpages, browse connected accounts, boards, board lists and board sections, create and manage boards, research public Pinterest group boards by topic, review drafts and recommended posting times, check an account's subscription status, manage a saved keywords list, schedule Pins, edit the copy on drafts and scheduled Pins, and delete unpublished Pins through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Tailwind 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 从网页生成 Pinterest Pin 草稿，浏览已连接的账户、画板、画板列表和分区，创建和管理画板，按主题研究公开的 Pinterest 群组画板，查看草稿和推荐发布时间，检查账户订阅状态，管理已保存的关键词列表，安排 Pin 发布，编辑草稿和已排期 Pin 的文案，并删除尚未发布的 Pin。

payload.name: AdKit - Ads Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AdKit connects your ad accounts to ChatGPT so you can manage advertising in plain language. 

Analyze campaign performance, create campaign drafts, research competitor ads, and generate ad creatives across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Reddit Ads workflows. 

Changes stay draft-first for review and only publish after explicit approval, so ChatGPT can help you move faster without silently changing live campaigns.
payload.longDescription:
AdKit 将广告账户连接至 ChatGPT，让你用自然语言管理广告。

在 Google Ads、Meta Ads、TikTok Ads 和 Reddit Ads 工作流程中，分析营销活动表现、创建活动草稿、研究竞争对手广告并生成广告创意。

变更会先保留为草稿供审核，仅在明确批准后发布，让 ChatGPT 帮你更快推进工作，而不会悄然修改正在投放的活动。

payload.name: Twenty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Twenty helps users work with their CRM workspace from ChatGPT by discovering available tools, learning tool schemas, searching Twenty documentation, loading workspace skills, and executing permitted CRM actions such as finding, creating, updating, or deleting records and drafting or sending email when the user's role allows it.
payload.longDescription: Twenty 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用 CRM 工作区：发现可用工具、了解工具架构、搜索 Twenty 文档、加载工作区技能，并执行获准的 CRM 操作，例如查找、创建、更新或删除记录，以及在用户角色获准时起草或发送电子邮件。

payload.name: Nifty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Nifty to ChatGPT to analyze and organize your reselling business across every marketplace you sell on. ChatGPT can search and filter inventory, pull full item details and photos, check inventory health, manage favorites, private notes, and labels, review order history and expenses, edit items and update marketplace listings, and analyze sales, profit, and sell-through. Nifty unifies inventory and sales for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, and Whatnot.
payload.longDescription: 将 Nifty 连接到 ChatGPT，分析并整理你在各个市场经营的转售业务。ChatGPT 可以搜索和筛选库存，获取完整商品详情和照片，检查库存状况，管理收藏、私密备注和标签，查看订单历史和费用，编辑商品并更新市场列表，还能分析销售、利润和售罄率。Nifty 统一管理 eBay、Poshmark、Mercari、Depop、Etsy 和 Whatnot 上转售商的库存与销售。

payload.name: FullEnrich
payload.description: 查找 B2B 联系人和公司
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FullEnrich helps ChatGPT find and enrich B2B prospects. Search for the right people or companies, get verified emails and phone numbers, and build prospect lists without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: FullEnrich 帮助 ChatGPT 查找并补充 B2B 潜在客户信息。搜索合适的人士或公司，获取经过验证的电子邮件地址和电话号码，并在对话中直接建立潜在客户名单。

payload.name: Markifact - Ads & Analytics
payload.description: 运行 Google Ads、Meta 及其他 50 多个平台
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Markifact is a marketing automation and advertising management connector for ChatGPT. Built for marketers, agencies, media buyers, PPC specialists, growth teams, and in-house marketing teams who need cross-channel reporting, paid media analysis, and campaign management without switching between ad dashboards.

Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, Snapchat Ads, Pinterest Ads, Amazon Ads, Apple Search Ads, OpenAI Ads (ChatGPT ads), Display & Video 360 (DV360), Spotify Ads, Data Manager.

Analytics and data: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Trends, Google Search, BigQuery, SEMrush, Adjust, Bing Webmaster Tools, PageSpeed Insights.

E-commerce and CRM: Shopify, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and Google Merchant Center.

Workspace and reporting: Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Docs, Google Drive, Microsoft SharePoint (OneDrive), Dropbox, Google Business Profile, and Google Maps.

Social and messaging: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Slack, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp.

Use Markifact for cross-channel advertising reports, PPC reporting, campaign audits, account monitoring, budget pacing, search term and keyword analysis, creative performance analysis, marketing data extraction, and campaign optimization. ChatGPT can retrieve campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, audiences, budgets, conversions, performance metrics, dimensions, and account structures from any connected account.

Markifact also supports advertising automation. Create campaigns and ads, update budgets and bids, pause or enable campaigns, edit supported ad fields, upload images and video, manage targeting, and run other platform-supported actions, then send results straight to Google Sheets, Slides, Docs, or Slack.
payload.longDescription:
Markifact 是面向 ChatGPT 的营销自动化和广告管理连接器，服务营销人员、机构、媒体投放人员、PPC 专家、增长团队和内部营销团队，让他们无需在广告仪表板之间切换，即可进行跨渠道报告、付费媒体分析和活动管理。

广告平台：Google Ads、Meta Ads（Facebook 和 Instagram）、Microsoft Ads、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、Reddit Ads、Snapchat Ads、Pinterest Ads、Amazon Ads、Apple Search Ads、OpenAI Ads（ChatGPT 广告）、Display & Video 360（DV360）、Spotify Ads、Data Manager。

分析和数据：Google Analytics 4（GA4）、Google Search Console、Google Tag Manager（GTM）、Google Trends、Google Search、BigQuery、SEMrush、Adjust、Bing Webmaster Tools、PageSpeed Insights。

电商和 CRM：Shopify、HubSpot、Klaviyo 和 Google Merchant Center。

工作区和报告：Google Sheets、Google Slides、Google Docs、Google Drive、Microsoft SharePoint（OneDrive）、Dropbox、Google Business Profile 和 Google Maps。

社交和消息：Facebook、Instagram、LinkedIn、Slack、Pinterest、YouTube、TikTok、WhatsApp。

使用 Markifact 进行跨渠道广告报告、PPC 报告、营销活动审计、账户监控、预算节奏控制、搜索词和关键词分析、创意表现分析、营销数据提取及营销活动优化。ChatGPT 可以从任何已连接账户中获取营销活动、广告组、广告、关键词、受众、预算、转化、表现指标、维度和账户结构。

payload.name: GoDaddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Our app makes it easy to search for and buy available domains. Simply type in your idea and see what's available on GoDaddy.com right now. If your first choice is taken, we'll show you amazing alternatives. Best used for checking domain availability and exploring options you hadn't even thought of yet.
payload.longDescription: 我们的应用让你轻松搜索并购买可用域名。只需输入你的想法，就能查看 GoDaddy.com 当前可注册的域名。如果首选已被注册，我们会为你展示出色的替代选项。此应用尤其适合查询域名是否可用，并探索你可能尚未想到的其他选择。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Instagram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Instagram helps creators and marketers analyze live Instagram organic performance. Users can discover connected Instagram Business or Creator accounts, inspect valid fields and options, query account and media insights — followers, reach, impressions, profile and website clicks, and engagement — and connect the Instagram connector. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Instagram 帮助创作者和营销人员分析实时 Instagram 自然流量成效。用户可以发现已连接的 Instagram Business 或 Creator 账户，查看有效字段和选项，查询账户及媒体洞察数据——粉丝数、触达量、展示次数、个人资料和网站点击量、互动情况——并连接 Instagram 连接器。它仅涵盖 Instagram 自然流量分析：不执行写入操作（未启用 Instagram 发布功能）、不涵盖 Instagram Ads（请使用 Meta Ads 连接器），也不提供广告费用数据。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Retell AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle phone calls for your business. Retell powers call center automation for receptionists, sales outreach, collections, customer support, and more. Use ChatGPT to create agent prompts, configure call transfers, edit settings, and deploy to live phone numbers - all conversationally.
payload.longDescription:
该插件构建并部署语音代理。以下功能和限制适用：
Build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle phone calls for your business. Retell powers call center automation for receptionists, sales outreach, collections, customer support, and more. Use ChatGPT to create agent prompts, configure call transfers, edit settings, and deploy to live phone numbers - all conversationally.

payload.name: Infojobs Brasil
payload.description: 在 Infojobs Brasil 找工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Acesse milhares de vagas de emprego no Brasil diretamente do ChatGPT. Pesquise por palavra-chave e localização, filtre por tipo de contrato e salário. Visualize os resultados em cards interativos com informações completas de cada vaga: empresa, localização, salário e descrição. Clique para ver detalhes completos no Infojobs Brasil.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 搜索巴西数千个工作职位。按关键词和地点搜索，并按合同类型和薪资筛选。通过交互式卡片查看职位完整信息，包括公司、地点、薪资和职位描述。点击即可在 Infojobs Brasil 查看完整详情。

payload.name: PDF Editor by PDF net
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in ChatGPT. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.

Edit PDFs in place: change text, fix dates, fill forms. Generate new PDFs from a prompt — invoices, contracts, proposals. Merge up to 20 PDFs, split by page range, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Organize your library into folders.

Working with PDFs can be slow. You convert to Word to edit, switch tools to merge, pay extra to translate, and dig through folders to find the file. pdf.net puts all of it in one chat.

Edit PDFs in place — no Word roundtrip. Generate invoices, contracts, and proposals from a prompt. Merge up to 20 files, split by page, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Your pdf.net library stays connected, so files are one message away.
payload.longDescription:
将 pdf.net 连接到 ChatGPT，以便编辑、生成和整理 PDF。你的 pdf.net 资料库会直接连接，无需每次重新上传。

直接编辑 PDF：修改文本、修正日期、填写表单。通过提示词生成新 PDF，例如发票、合同和提案。最多合并 20 个 PDF，按页码范围拆分、压缩，并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档，同时保留版式。将资料库整理到文件夹中。

处理 PDF 可能很慢。你得先转换为 Word 才能编辑，切换工具来合并，额外付费翻译，还得翻找文件夹找文件。pdf.net 把这些操作全部放在一个聊天中。

直接编辑 PDF，无需往返转换 Word。通过提示词生成发票、合同和提案。最多合并 20 个文件，按页拆分、压缩，并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档并保留版式。你的 pdf.net 资料库保持连接，随时发条消息就能访问文件。

payload.name: iZap
payload.description: 管理 WhatsApp 企业业务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect iZap to manage your WhatsApp customer conversations without leaving the chat. Check how your day is going at a glance — message volume, how much your AI assistant is handling versus your team, and how long conversations are taking. Search and read your chat history, look up contacts, and send WhatsApp messages or approved templates on the spot. Launch broadcast campaigns with a preview step before anything goes out, and track their delivery. You can also set up and fine-tune the AI assistants that reply to your customers — create a new one or update its instructions in seconds.

Everything runs against your own authenticated iZap business, so you see your real numbers and your real conversations.
payload.longDescription:
连接 iZap，在聊天中管理 WhatsApp 客户对话。查看消息量、AI 助手与团队处理比例和对话时长；搜索和阅读历史、查找联系人、发送消息或已批准模板；预览后发起广播并跟踪送达；设置和微调回复客户的 AI 助手。所有操作都针对经过认证的

iZap 企业账户，显示真实数据和对话。

payload.name: Business Helper
payload.description: 有来源支持的商业答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Business Helper improves ChatGPT answers to business questions by adding reliable, source-
backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about strategy, product, marketing, or operations, the app enriches responses
with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it
clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally
without external references.

Business Helper does not collect personal data, and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based on user's intentions only.
payload.longDescription:
Business Helper 通过加入来自可信专家材料的可靠、有来源支持的上下文，改善 ChatGPT 对商业问题的回答。

当用户询问战略、产品、营销或运营时，应用会用相关示例和现实洞察参考来丰富回答。只有在明确能提升实用性时才会加入上下文；如果找不到相关来源，ChatGPT 会像平常一样回答，不添加外部引用。

Business Helper 不收集个人数据，也不提供专业法律或财务建议。任何外部服务都只根据用户意图推荐。

payload.name: Namify
payload.description: 从创意到域名，即刻完成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. Describe your business in plain language, drop in a one-word concept, or paste a seed domain with a preferred extension, and Namify instantly returns relevant name suggestions with live availability across multiple TLDs.

What makes Namify different is that it doesn't stop at "is this domain free?" Every suggestion can be vetted for full brand-readiness: run a trademark check to spot legal conflicts, and a social-handle check to confirm the name is available across major platforms. It is domain discovery built for people who want a name that actually works as a brand — not just a URL that happens to be unregistered.

Best used for naming a new business, side project, app, or product launch — and going from idea to a domain you can register in a single conversation.
payload.longDescription:
Namify 将一个想法变成可打造品牌且可注册的域名，无需反复把各种变体输入搜索框。用自然语言描述业务、输入一个单词概念，或粘贴带首选后缀的种子域名，Namify 就会即时返回相关名称建议，并显示多个 TLD 的实时可用性。

Namify 的特点不止于回答“这个域名是否空闲”。每个建议都可进行完整品牌就绪检查：运行商标检查以发现法律冲突，并检查社交账号名称以确认各大平台是否可用。它为希望名称真正适合作为品牌的人提供域名发现，而不只是一个碰巧未注册的 URL。

适用于为新企业、副业项目、应用或产品发布命名，并在一次对话中从想法走到可注册域名。

payload.name: AI Business Plan by PrometAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PrometAI helps users generate a complete business plan PDF from a few key business details. payload.longDescription: PrometAI 帮助用户根据少量关键业务信息生成完整的商业计划书 PDF。用户提供公司名称、业务描述、国家和电子邮件，随后 PrometAI 创建商业计划书，生成可下载的 PDF，并发送访问说明，方便用户在 PrometAI 平台继续编辑计划书。

payload.name: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale helps online sellers find products for their online stores. Discover millions of premium dropshipping and wholesale products from verified global suppliers. Ask for products by category, image, price, location, popularity, or minimum profit margin. Explore top-selling items, add products to your store, check orders and performance, and learn about Syncee in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale 帮助网店卖家为线上商店寻找商品。从经过验证的全球供应商处发现数百万种优质代发货和批发商品。可以按类别、图片、价格、地点、人气或最低利润率查找商品。探索畅销商品、将商品添加到商店、查看订单和业绩，并在 ChatGPT 中了解 Syncee。

payload.name: Zendrop
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zendrop helps ecommerce merchants manage dropshipping operations from ChatGPT. Users can search the Zendrop catalog, add and import products to connected stores, inspect store, order, billing, and performance data, update fulfillment and tracking settings, preview fulfillment costs, and confirm guarded order fulfillment, cancellation, address, and product-linking workflows.
payload.longDescription: Zendrop 帮助电商商家直接在 ChatGPT 中管理一件代发业务。用户可以搜索 Zendrop 商品目录、将商品添加并导入已连接的商店、查看商店、订单、账单和业绩数据、更新履约和物流跟踪设置、预览履约成本，并确认受保护的订单履约、取消、地址及商品关联流程。

payload.name: Seismic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Seismic MCP Connector for ChatGPT enables secure integration between ChatGPT and Seismic, allowing ChatGPT to generate accurate, Seismic-specific responses using approved sales and enablement content.

Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the connector provides authentication and scope-based access control, ensuring only authorized tools and content are available within ChatGPT.

To configure access, users must install the MCP Connector for ChatGPT app from Seismic Exchange, where tenant admins define scopes and permissions that control which Seismic capabilities are exposed.

Once configured:

ChatGPT connects to Seismic through the MCP server

Only approved tools and content are accessible

Responses are grounded in trusted, compliant materials

Without proper installation and scope configuration, Seismic tools will not be visible in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
适用于 ChatGPT 的 Seismic MCP Connector 可在 ChatGPT 与 Seismic 之间实现安全集成，让 ChatGPT 使用获批的销售和赋能内容生成准确、针对 Seismic 的回复。

该连接器基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 构建，提供身份验证和基于范围的访问控制，确保 ChatGPT 中仅开放获授权的工具和内容。

要配置访问权限，用户必须从 Seismic Exchange 安装适用于 ChatGPT 的 MCP Connector 应用；租户管理员会在其中定义要开放的 Seismic 功能范围及权限。

配置完成后：

ChatGPT 通过 MCP 服务器连接 Seismic

仅可访问获批的工具和内容

回复以可信、合规的材料为依据

如果没有正确安装和配置访问范围，Seismic 工具将不会在 ChatGPT 中显示。

payload.name: iubenda
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language. Run cookie scans to detect trackers, then update your policies to match as your site changes. Built for founders, agencies, and developers who need to meet GDPR, ePrivacy, US state privacy laws, and privacy requirements across markets, without the manual overhead.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 助手连接到 iubenda，从头到尾处理网站法律合规。通过自然语言创建和管理网站，生成根据所用服务定制的隐私和 Cookie 政策，添加数据处理服务，设置 Cookie 同意横幅并起草条款。运行 Cookie 扫描检测跟踪器，并在网站变化时更新政策。面向需要满足 GDPR、ePrivacy、美国州隐私法及各市场隐私要求的创始人、代理商和开发者。

payload.name: Ashby
payload.description: 分析招聘数据并采取行动
payload.summaryOriginal: Analyze and act on hiring data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ashby in ChatGPT gives you instant access to your pipeline, candidate profiles, open jobs, interviews, and transcripts. Ask questions, uncover hiring trends, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the chat. Ashby connects ChatGPT to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth. Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.

Try prompts like these:
“Summarize our current engineering pipeline, highlight bottlenecks, and identify at-risk candidates.”
"Consider [Candidate Name] for our open Staff Engineer role and move them to the recruiter screen stage."
“Generate a debrief summary for [Candidate Name] using interview feedback, scorecards, and recruiter notes.”
“Analyze time-to-fill trends across sales roles and summarize where delays are occurring.”
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT 中的 Ashby 让你即时访问招聘流程、候选人资料、在招职位、面试及文字记录。提问、发现招聘趋势，并直接在聊天中添加备注、调整候选人所处阶段或发送邮件。Ashby 通过安全的用户级 OAuth，将 ChatGPT 连接到实时招聘数据。每项请求和操作都遵循你现有的权限，确保数据受到保护。

可以尝试以下提示词：
“总结我们当前的工程岗位招聘流程，指出瓶颈，并找出有流失风险的候选人。”
“考虑让 [候选人姓名] 应聘我们在招的 Staff Engineer 岗位，并将其移至招聘人员初筛阶段。”
“利用面试反馈、评分表和招聘人员备注，生成 [候选人姓名] 的面试复盘摘要。”
“分析销售岗位招聘周期的变化趋势，并总结延误发生在哪些环节。”

payload.name: AWeber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The AWeber MCP connects your AI assistant to your AWeber account, letting you manage email marketing through natural language. Instead of logging into AWeber, you can ask your assistant to manage subscribers, draft emails, analyze campaigns, and more — all through simple conversational requests.
payload.longDescription: AWeber MCP 将AI助手连接到你的 AWeber 账户，让你通过自然语言管理电子邮件营销。无需登录 AWeber，你可以通过简单的对话请求，让助手管理订阅者、起草邮件、分析营销活动，以及执行更多操作。

payload.name: Constant Contact
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Go from email idea to a polished, ready-to-send campaign with the Constant Contact app. Describe the email you want, and the Constant Contact app will generate the HTML and render a live preview. Not quite right? Give feedback in chat, make edits, and preview again until it's exactly what you want. When you're ready to send, connect or create a Constant Contact account to import your email and reach your audience.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Constant Contact 应用，将邮件创意转化为精致且可直接发送的营销活动。描述你想要的邮件，Constant Contact 应用就会生成 HTML 并呈现实时预览。效果不理想？在聊天中提供反馈、进行修改并再次预览，直到完全符合你的要求。准备发送时，连接或创建 Constant Contact 账户，导入邮件并触达受众。

payload.name: Best Lawyers
payload.description: 搜索获同行认可的律师
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for lawyers by practice area and location. Use the Best Lawyers directory to find peer-recognized attorneys by specialty (e.g. Corporate Law, Personal Injury), city, state, and country. Optionally filter to Lawyers of the Year. Results are based on Best Lawyers’ peer-review process.
payload.longDescription: 按执业领域和地点搜索律师。使用 Best Lawyers 目录，按专业（例如公司法、人身伤害）、城市、州和国家寻找获同行认可的律师。还可筛选年度律师。结果基于 Best Lawyers 的同行评审流程。

payload.name: Teamtailor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Teamtailor Public MCP lets authorized users search recruiting workspace data, inspect jobs, candidates, questions, organization structure and meeting records, and update job configuration, application questions, interview kits and skills from ChatGPT using the user's Teamtailor permissions.
payload.longDescription: Teamtailor Public MCP 允许获授权用户使用 ChatGPT 搜索招聘工作区数据、查看职位、候选人、问题、组织结构和会议记录，并根据用户的 Teamtailor 权限更新职位配置、申请问题、面试套件和技能。

payload.name: Apartments.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search millions of rental listings on Apartments.com directly from your conversation. Tell the assistant what you're looking for — city, neighborhood, price range, bedrooms, pet policy, amenities — and get curated results with photos, pricing, and availability in seconds. 

From a single chat you can explore floor plans, check unit availability, review fees and lease policies, get neighborhood insights, estimate affordability, schedule a tour, or contact a property directly.
